methodology: Preliminary verse-by-verse topical screening. Earlier texts consulted in named ESV English translation only; Hebrew/Arabic critical editions, variants and manuscript dates not collated. No assertion of textual dependence. 'needs_further_research' is not a no-parallel finding.

verses.summary: Every community's witness and Muhammad as witness; eschatological testimony
Disbelievers' wish to be leveled with earth and inability to conceal speech
Prayer while intoxicated; ritual impurity, washing and dry ablution
People given a portion of scripture choosing error and wishing others astray
God's knowledge of adversaries and sufficiency as protector
Accusation that some among the Jews alter words from their places and use derisive expressions
Call to believe revelation confirming what is with the addressees; warning of judgment
God's forgiveness and the condemnation of associating partners

staged_candidates.difference: Isaiah addresses Israel as witness to God's unique divinity; Qur'an 4:41 describes eschatological witnesses from communities and Muhammad as witness

staged_candidates.similarity: Both concern integrity of transmitted divine instruction
staged_candidates.difference: Deuteronomy prohibits adding to or subtracting from commandments; Qur'an 4:46 accuses particular interlocutors of displacing or distorting words and speech
